_notes.rootDirectory: Set the service Root Directory to 'backend' in the Railway dashboard so the build context (and .dockerignore) is backend/. Then dockerfilePath 'Dockerfile' resolves to backend/Dockerfile.
_notes.volume: Attach a Railway volume mounted at /data (SINGULARITY_DATA) so the SQLite DB survives redeploys.
_notes.env: Set in the dashboard / `railway variables`: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, SINGULARITY_ADMIN_TOKEN, SINGULARITY_ENABLE_SCHEDULER=true, SINGULARITY_WAKE_HOUR=9, SINGULARITY_TZ=UTC, SINGULARITY_DATA=/data, SINGULARITY_DB=/data/singularity.db. Never commit secrets.
